# Every Song Is a Website

> A small gallery where each song gets its own visual world. Pick a door.

Site: https://music.significanthobbies.com

## What it is

A static, dependency-free gallery: one self-contained interactive world per
song at `/<slug>/`. Eight curated songs get bespoke configs; the rest of the
100+ song catalog inherit themed defaults (frames, artifacts, chat, seeded
scatter layout). Themes are runtime-switchable.

## Structure

- `/` — the gallery index with live filter search
- `/<slug>/` — one visual world per song (143 songs)
- `/sitemap.xml` — full URL list

## License notes

Lyrics render via Genius's official embed (licensed, never scraped). Player
frames embed YouTube. Hand-written lines are original demo text only.

Maintained by Sarthak Agrawal: https://sarthakagrawal.dev
